definitions.explanation: The end of a fiscal or academic year. In Japan, the fiscal year typically ends on March 31st, making late March a particularly busy time for businesses and schools.

examples.english: The end of the fiscal year is busy.

examples.english: Use up the budget by the end of the fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {年度末|ねんどまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。

⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧ (fiscal/academic year) + {末|まつ} (end)

JAPANESE FISCAL YEAR:
In Japan, the fiscal year ({会計年度|かいけいねんど}) runs from April 1st to March 31st. The academic year follows the same pattern. This makes late March ({年度末|ねんどまつ}) extremely busy.

COMMON ACTIVITIES:
- ⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧ (financial closing)
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧ (budget utilization)
- ⟦{人事異動|じんじいどう}→人事異動：18627_jinjiidou⟧ (personnel transfers)
- ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧/⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧ (graduation/enrollment)
